title: Anuvani-LID: Robust and Calibrated Spoken Language Identification for Indian Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.20263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every multilingual speech pipeline begins with a language decision, an error there propagates silently through recognition, translation and routing. In India it spans 22 scheduled languages across four language families, heard over short, noisy, narrowband and code-mixed audio. Foundational speech models increasingly present language identification (LID) as an inherent latent, generalized capability. Autoregressive decoders in speech models emit a special language ID token, and modern LLMs with audio capabilities can name the language when prompted. We test this assumption on identical clips and find that whisper and similar speech models has tokens for only 15 of the 23 languages, on one second inputs Gemini 3.5 Flash reaches 0.52 macro-F1 and GPT-audio 0.14. We present Anuvani LID, a dedicated 115M parameter LID conformer model trained on 54,643 hours of Indian speech spanning 22 Indian languages and Indian accented English. Along with

translated_title: Anuvani-LID：面向印度语言的鲁棒且校准良好的口语语言识别
translated_abstract: 每个多语言语音处理流水线都始于一个语言判定，而该环节的错误会悄无声息地在识别、翻译和路由中传播。在印度，这涉及横跨四大语系的22种表列语言，且这些语言常出现在短促、嘈杂、窄带以及语码混杂的音频中。基础语音模型越来越倾向于将语言识别（LID）视为一种固有的、潜在的可泛化能力。语音模型中的自回归解码器会输出一个特殊的语言ID标记，而具备音频能力的现代大语言模型在被提示时也能说出语言名称。我们在相同的音频片段上测试了这一假设，发现Whisper及类似语音模型仅对23种语言中的15种具有语言标记；在1秒输入下，Gemini 3.5 Flash的宏平均F1仅为0.52，GPT-audio仅为0.14。我们提出了Anuvani-LID，一个专用的1.15亿参数LID Conformer模型，在54,643小时的印度语语音上训练，涵盖22种印度语言及印度口音英语。同时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Anuvani-LID，一个在54,643小时印度语语音上训练的1.15亿参数专用Conformer语言识别模型，覆盖22种印度语言及印度口音英语，在短促、嘈杂、窄带等困难条件下显著优于Whisper等基础语音模型及Gemini、GPT等音频大语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Anuvani-LID, a dedicated 115M-parameter conformer model for spoken language identification trained on 54,643 hours of Indian speech covering 22 Indian languages and Indian-accented English, which substantially outperforms foundation speech models like Whisper and audio-capable LLMs like Gemini and GPT under challenging conditions.
